name: CLI Bulk Recall
statement: A developer recalls beliefs for multiple subjects in a single command, receiving grouped results that reduce round-trips compared to individual recall calls.
successCriteria: limen recall-bulk --subjects 'entity:project:alpha,entity:user:bob' returns JSON array with one result set per subject
Each result set contains subject (string) and beliefs (array) fields
limen recall-bulk --subjects 'entity:test:x' --limit 5 limits results per subject
Failed subjects include an error field instead of crashing the entire call
All stdout is valid JSON, all errors go to stderr as JSON
failureCriteria: limen recall-bulk without --subjects produces non-JSON error or crashes
limen recall-bulk --subjects '' (empty) crashes instead of returning JSON error
limen recall-bulk --limit 'abc' crashes instead of returning JSON error
A single failed subject causes the entire command to fail
Any command outputs non-JSON to stdout
preconditions: limen init completed (~/.limen/ exists with master key and config)
